<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (twice), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, and 116.65 (twice). All of these fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–150 ppm). That gives 11 aromatic carbon signals. The remaining peaks (166.00, 61.10, 14.26) correspond to carbonyl, oxygen‑bound carbon, and aliphatic carbon, respectively, and are not aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
